visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit garage, a young man with blonde hair, glasses, and a white hard hat wearing a black t-shirt stands under a car lift. He holds a bright LED light wand, pointing it upwards while gesturing animatedly towards the camera. Beside him, an older man in a black polo shirt with a headlamp on his forehead looks up at the car's undercarriage. (2) The camera switches to extreme close-ups of the car's underside, specifically showing metallic pipes and the engine bay area. A hand wearing a silver watch points at specific components that appear oxidized. The environment is filled with tool racks, red toolboxes, and mechanical equipment in the background. (3) The host removes his hard hat, revealing his hair, and continues talking while standing near the car lift. He uses the light wand to emphasize his points. Yellow and red variety-style text overlays appear frequently. (4) The scene shifts to the front of a white Volkswagen GTI parked in the shop. The camera pans from the front grille to the side. The lighting is bright and even. (5) The host opens the trunk to reveal a custom audio modification with a large speaker and 'YUWEI EDITION' text lit up. He points at the wiring and the brand logo on the subwoofer. (6) The host sits in the driver's seat, then moves to the passenger seat to demonstrate the manual adjustment dial for the seatback. He uses his hands to turn the dial and gestures towards the interior dashboard which has a digital screen. (7) Finally, the host points at a maintenance sticker on the inside of the windshield, then stands by the open hood of the car, looking directly into the camera while concluding his talk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-energy speech from a young male host accompanied by an upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM. A sharp 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effect punctuate the first transition. The vocal delivery is fast-paced and excited, with high pitch variability. (2) A metallic 'clink' and the sound of an impact wrench introduce the inspection phase. The mechanic's voice is heard, deeper and more professional, contrasting with the host's high-arousal tone. The BGM continues as a steady rhythmic bed. (3) A loud 'applause' and 'laughter' sound effect marks a comedic moment as the host removes his helmet. This is followed by a digital 'pop' sound effect as graphics appear on screen. The host's speech remains dominant and dense. (4) A low-frequency 'riser' and a heavy 'thud' impact SFX transition to the car reveal. The BGM swells slightly in brightness. Camera shutter sound effects are audible, simulating professional photography. (5) The sound of the car trunk latch clicking open is heard, followed by more digital UI 'ping' sounds highlighting the modified speaker system. The host's voice exhibits high projection and clarity. (6) Rapid 'whoosh' transitions accompany cuts between interior seat demonstrations. The BGM tempo feels faster as the editing pace increases. (7) A bright 'bell' SFX rings when the maintenance sticker is shown. The video ends with a final energetic phrase from the host and a quick fade-out of the music and ambient garage tone.
